title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a satellite-height marker to the Session 1 period graph
body:
## Problem
The period graph in the Session 1 app does not mark famous orbits.

## Context
Markers for the space station height and the geostationary height help beginners connect the curve to real satellites.

## Expected outcome
Two labelled markers on the period graph, readable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both markers labelled with altitude and period
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: split the plane change between burns
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Session 3 puts all of the plane change in one burn.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: a full rendezvous planner
body:
## Problem
Session 3 can catch a target in a similar orbit, but cannot plan a transfer followed by a phasing wait.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that return the burns and the meeting time, verified by integration.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Integrated chaser ends within 1 km of the target
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: animated transfer with equal-area sweeps
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a transfer with burn markers, velocity vectors, equal-area sweeps and a delta-v comparison; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The two wedge areas agree to within 0.1 percent
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
